title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:15:0:00015:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 15 (Establishment and Operation of the Conflict Management Policy Coordination Committee)
① The Conflict Management Policy Coordination Committee (hereinafter referred to as "the Committee") as defined in Article 26(5) of the Act shall be composed of no more than 25 members, including one chairperson.
② The chairperson shall be the Director of the Presidential Office for Policy Coordination, and the members shall be the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Science and Technology Information and Communication, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Education, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of National Defense, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Administration and National Security, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Climate and Energy and Environment, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Labor and Employment, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Vice Chair of the Broadcasting and Media Communication Committee, the Chief of the Fire Department, the Director of the National Heritage Administration, the Director of the Forest Service, or any other official or head of a related ministry or department designated by the chairperson. In the case of institutions with multiple vice ministers, the vice minister designated by the head of the institution shall be appointed. (Amended March 23, 2013, August 10, 2017, October 31, 2025, January 30, 2026)
③ The Committee shall deliberate and coordinate the following matters:
1. Prevention and resolution of public conflicts

Items related to legal revisions and other improvements, as well as matters related to education and publicity concerning public conflict
2. Items related to education and publicity concerning public conflict
3. Any other matters that the chairperson deems necessary for the Policy Coordination Committee to review concerning public conflict
4. One secretary will be appointed to handle the affairs of the Policy Coordination Committee, and the secretary will be the Director of the Policy and Coordination Division of the National Policy Office. (Amended on 2008.7.2, 2013.3.23)
